_comment: MCP server registry consumed by legal_helper/mcp/registry.py. US sources (CourtListener, eCFR, Federal Register, GovInfo) are served by direct-API connectors in legal_helper/connectors/, not MCP. All PKULaw sub-services share PKULAW_API_TOKEN via the WSO2 apikey header. Activation is gated by active_domain_packs and jurisdictions. stdio `command` values stay bare on purpose: registry.resolve_command() resolves them against the harness interpreter and the llm conda env (python -> sys.executable, npx -> the env bin dir), so the file stays portable instead of hardcoding this machine's paths. Override the env name with LEGAL_HELPER_MCP_ENV.

pkulaw_law_search._description: Semantic search + retrieval of PRC law articles (get_article, search_article).

pkulaw_fatiao._description: Precise 法条 by title + 条号 (get_law_item_content).

pkulaw_case_search._description: Semantic search over PRC 司法案例 (search_case).

pkulaw_case_list._description: Keyword case-judgment list by 标题 / 正文 (get_case_list).

pkulaw_anhao._description: 案号 extraction + normalization against the PKULaw 案例库 (anhao_recognition).

pkulaw_law_recognition._description: Statute / 法条 reference extraction + traceability (law_recognition).

pkulaw_doc_link._description: Auto-link 法规 references in prose to pkulaw.com (get_linked_content).

pkulaw_nl_search._description: NL-SQL semantic search across statutes, cases, articles, 检察文书, 律所文章 (ai_pkulaw_search).
